name: Galaxy S20 rear wide — alpha750 15DoF demo
description: Controlled phone demo using the learned cross-modal alpha750 checkpoint; camera/IMU calibration is copied from the measured provisional S20 profile.

camera.calibration_method: OpenCV checkerboard calibration, 640x480, 10x7 inner corners, RMS 0.4644 px

imu.calibration_method: PROVISIONAL only: R_CI and -23 ms offset from four-session joint rotation/time validation; t_CI is the robust component median of target sessions 1, 3, and 4 after excluding session 2; stationary Allan noise uses conservative per-axis maxima. gyro_random_walk=2e-5 is a conservative plateau-derived bound, not a directly observed random-walk slope.

provenance.rotation_time: four-session joint rotation/time calibration; raw capture artifacts are not bundled
provenance.stationary_allan: stationary Allan analysis; raw capture artifacts are not bundled
limitations: Gyro random walk was not directly observed in the stationary Allan slope region.
Use only for controlled 15DoF runtime comparison; do not report it as a final metrology calibration.
provenance.runtime_model: alpha750: direct R/v/p confidence plus learned global cross-modal calibration
provenance.calibration_copied_from: internal Galaxy S20 provisional calibration profile
provenance.imu_gap_policy: No hard keyframe-duration cutoff in VI initialization or full 15DoF IMU BA; invalid/missing measurements can still be rejected.
